title: Unexpected user logouts resolved by restarting auth-service
summary: Several team members reported being logged out last night. Bob restarted auth-service and the issue appeared to stop. The cause and scope are not yet known.
severityRationale: The notes do not say how many users were affected or for how long.
impact: Some users were logged out; the number affected is unknown.
detection: Reports from people in the team channel.

timeline.description: Team members reported being logged out
Bob restarted auth-service; behaviour returned to normal

actionItems.description: Review auth-service logs to find the cause of the logouts

openQuestions: When did it start and stop?
